# Eased

Eased is a library of motion-first React components for shadcn, installed with the shadcn CLI.

[eased.dev](https://eased.dev/?ref=github) · [Components](https://eased.dev/components?ref=github) · [Docs](https://eased.dev/docs/introduction?ref=github)

This repository is the free, MIT-licensed part of Eased: the source of every free component, its docs, and the registry JSON that `eased.dev/r` serves.

## Install

Add a component with the shadcn CLI, by its registry name or by its URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/button
```

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/button.json
```

`@eased/<name>` works because Eased is listed in the [shadcn registry index](https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json), so the CLI finds `@eased` without a `registries` entry in `components.json`.

The URL form needs the `.json` extension: `https://eased.dev/r/button.json` works, `https://eased.dev/r/button` returns 404.

The CLI copies the component's source into `components/eased/<name>/`, installs its npm dependencies and merges the Eased stylesheet into your global CSS. There is no CSS file to import. You own the code from then on.

### Requirements

- React 19
- Tailwind CSS v4
- A `components.json`. If your project doesn't have one, run `npx shadcn init`.

The CLI installs each component's npm dependencies for you. Across the free components these are `@base-ui/react` (36), `@tanstack/react-table` (2), `d3-scale` (1), `d3-shape` (1), `motion` (55), `shiki` (3), with the number of components that use each.

## For AI agents

- [llms.txt](https://eased.dev/llms.txt?ref=github): the index of the docs and every component
- [llms-full.txt](https://eased.dev/llms-full.txt?ref=github): the docs and every free component's page in one file
- [Motion docs](https://eased.dev/docs/motion?ref=github): the springs, curves and durations every component uses
- [AI and MCP docs](https://eased.dev/docs/ai-mcp?ref=github): the MCP server, the skill and per-client setup

### MCP server

The Eased MCP server is at `https://eased.dev/api/mcp`. Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http eased https://eased.dev/api/mcp
```

Cursor, in `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "eased": {
      "url": "https://eased.dev/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Skills

```bash
npx skills add easedui/skills
```

Installs `eased-motion`: the motion rules only.

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/eased-skill.json
```

Installs `eased-skill`: the full Eased design skill, written to `.claude/skills/eased/SKILL.md`.

## Accessibility

Every animated component respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. From the [motion docs](https://eased.dev/docs/motion?ref=github):

> Every animated component has a reduced branch. When the visitor's system asks for reduced motion, movement becomes a 100ms opacity fade (`reducedFade`) or nothing, and looping animations stop.

## Licence

The free components are MIT: see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Eased Pro is a separate paid tier, at [eased.dev](https://eased.dev/?ref=github#pricing). Pro source isn't in this repository.

## What's here

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `src/registry/eased/<name>/` | A component's source and its `README.md` (usage, props, motion) |
| `src/registry/eased/_primitives/` | Shared primitives the components build on |
| `src/registry/eased/lib/` | Shared helpers: springs and durations (`motion.ts`), press styles (`press.ts`), and DOM, platform and format helpers |
| `src/registry/eased/mac-*/` | Mac components for Tauri and Electron apps, each with its Tauri window config |
| `docs/` | The docs as Markdown: installation, theming, motion, AI and MCP, and one page per component |
| `public/r/` | The built registry JSON |
| `registry.json` | The registry manifest. The Eased stylesheet is its `eased-tokens` item |
| `context7.json` | Settings for [Context7](https://context7.com) |
